podcast.title: Illuminati Clone Theory
podcast.body: A conspiracy theory suggests that Pete Wentz was abducted and killed by the Illuminati in 2009 or 2010 as part of a satanic sacrifice, then replaced by a man-made human clone. The supposed "proof" cited by a theorist was that "overnight He was no longer cute the bangs and the eyeliner were gone." Wentz himself retweeted a message on August 1, 2016, stating, "Pete died in 2010. He was cloned and replaced with an imposter." "The story is that the illuminati Well, I you didn't think that we would get through this whole show without mentioning them did you? The illuminati is engaged in a long-running plots where they abduct celebrities and kill them as part of satanic sacrifices That was a lot like human on doesn't it to cover up the crimes they are replaced by man-made humans who then go about their business as if nothing has happened This is what happened to Pete Wentz sometime in 2009 or 2010"

xref.title: Bipolar Disorder
xref.body: A significant factor in Scott Weiland's and Mary Forsberg's struggles was their undiagnosed bipolar disorder, which led to extreme mood swings and poor judgment, often exacerbated by self-medication with drugs like crack. Doctors initially misdiagnosed him with severe depression, and the treatments did not control his manic episodes. "A big part of their problems coping with life is that they were both undiagnosed sufferers of bipolar disorder, and this is a really important part of our story."

xref.title: Joe Biden's Accidental Role in Band Formation
xref.body: Fall Out Boy's existence is indirectly linked to Joe Biden. Pete Wentz's parents met while campaigning for Biden when he was running for Senator in the 1970s. A photograph even exists showing Biden posing with baby Pete Wentz. Therefore, without Biden's campaign, Wentz's parents might not have met, and Pete Wentz, and consequently Fall Out Boy, might not have formed. "Pete Wenz says his parents meant while campaigning for Biden when he was running for Senator in the 1970s."
